caption: The drawing features a wooden rocking chair with three horizontal slats forming the backrest and two rounded, vertical posts as the sides of the back. These posts have small decorative knobs at the top. The seat appears to be woven with a dark and light patterned material, possibly representing a cane or rush seat. The chair has two armrests that extend horizontally, supported by turned wooden posts. The rocker base consists of curved wooden runners connected by horizontal and diagonal supporting rods, and there is a visible mechanism beneath the seat suggesting a spring or swivel action that connects the seat to the rocker base. The wood is rendered in natural brown tones, with variations indicating shading and texture, and the woven seat displays a cross-hatched or diamond pattern in gray and brown hues. The background is plain and uncolored, and there is a small cursive signature in the bottom right corner that reads "Orville Cline."
title: Shaker Rocking Chair
